title: Filtration-dependent urate encoding in independent-cycle urinary albumin prediction
abstract: Adding a sex-specific urate–eGFR tensor spline changed independent-cycle weighted log-UACR MSE from 0.805069 to 0.811902 (delta +0.006833; joint PSU-bootstrap95% [+0.000714,+0.052086]). The registered improvement criterion was not met. Exploratory transfer, not untouched confirmation or causal evidence.
